title: Topic 5.5: Fruit of the Holy Spirit

pages.lesson:
LESSON: FRUIT OF THE HOLY SPIRIT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.5: Fruit of the Holy Spirit

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Fruit of the Holy Spirit. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: FRUIT OF THE HOLY SPIRIT
This lesson teaches Fruit of the Holy Spirit for Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Fruit of the Holy Spirit using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Fruit of the Holy Spirit above.
2. Explain Fruit of the Holy Spirit to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Fruit of the Holy Spirit.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Fruit of the Holy Spirit with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Fruit of the Holy Spirit important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
